I'm a member of the VRCFT discord that has been helping people with this OSC crash over the past few months. The one thing I have noticed with many of the users experiencing crashes with this is that they have parameters with special characters in the name, like square/curly brackets, question marks, commas, etc. These characters *probably* shouldn't be allowed in parameter names:

https://github.com/stella3d/OscCore/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/OscParser.cs#L128

The very first thing TryMatchPatternHandler does is check to see if the address contains one of these characters, which initially caused me to believe it might be related:

https://github.com/stella3d/OscCore/blob/9bdcf2dc9cae179ab1c3982847eba72432c042a5/Runtime/Scripts/OscAddressSpace.cs#L128

Note that VRCFT doesn't actually drive any of these parameters.

Additionally note that both myself and another VRCFT admin have not been able to reproduce the crash, even when creating an avatar with a bunch of the same avatar parameters causing problems for others. There seems to be another factor at play that causes the crash. In past incidents, users closing OVR Toolkit (which does send OSC data) fixed the problem for them, but this isn't universal.

We had two users remove the problematic parameters and they reported no further issues (including Saint of Sin below). Link to the Discord thread in VRCFT server:

https://discord.com/channels/849300336128032789/1354625420368285730

Also of note, Hai reported a similar OSC address name issue earlier that caused crashing *on load*, but this specific crash only occurs when receiving parameters. https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/expression-parameter-called-add-on-internally-crashes-osccore-and-fails-to-load

details:
I typically use VRCFT + a chatbox program in OSC and have been consistently having my OSC stop working after a few avatar changes or FBT calibrations/world changes

1. Have any program send any sort of OSC message to 9000 to make "first contact" (for testing purposes I used TouchOSC to send a completely random message to 9000, the default message being button1 or something)

2. Change avatars, FBT calibrate, or join new worlds multiple times, or once

3. OSC crashes and completely stops receiving/sending until a game restart

The error in question is:

2023.12.19 18:39:49 Exception  -  Object reference not set to an instance of an object.

  at OscCore.OscServer.TryMatchPatterns (OscCore.OscParser parser, System.Byte* bufferPtr, System.Int32 addressLength) [0x00000] in <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0 

  at OscCore.OscServer.ParseBuffer (System.Int32 byteLength) [0x00000] in <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0 

  at OscCore.OscSocket.Serve () [0x00000] in <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0 

  at System.Threading.ExecutionContext.RunInternal (System.Threading.ExecutionContext executionContext, System.Threading.ContextCallback callback, System.Object state, System.Boolean preserveSyncCtx) [0x00000] in <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0 

  at System.Threading.ExecutionContext.Run (System.Threading.ExecutionContext executionContext, System.Threading.ContextCallback callback, System.Object state) [0x00000] in <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0 

It does not happen to everyone, I have only found myself and 2-3 other people around discord with the same issue. It seems to be very inconsistent, I have no idea what is causing it. I can't find a root cause and relying a lot on OSC, it is getting frustrating

I don't know if it has something to do with something on my avatars? But I have changed nothing on them, except one has VRCFT parameters. I thought this could be it, but public avatars with VRCFT seem to be fine.

It only happens on a few recent avatars for me, but I know someone who is using public avatars with the same problem

I personally do not have the issue when using default VRChat avatars (robots for example)

It does not happen when using only OSCQuery Explorer: https://github.com/vrchat-community/vrc-oscquery-lib/releases

I have tried:

Clearing cache

OSC deleting folder/reset config

Reinstalling

Both live and open beta

The automatic method in this article: https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500002247921-VRChat-keeps-crashing-or-has-issues-launching-properly

Using VOR to filter bad packets

Set launch option to specifically use 9000 and 9001, doesn't matter with or without

Set launch options to use something other than 9000 and 9001

No other programs are using those ports

Example 1: https://youtu.be/SxqzmnOaWJk

I switched avatars a bunch PRIOR to sending anything to 9000, but the second I do, INSTANT crash. Almost like I have a limited amount of avatar changes and they got "queued up" 

Example 2:

https://youtu.be/0GkZAWq1fIs 

Changing avatars while already having sent a message to 9000, and continue to over the video. This took a while to crash but I usually have a max of 2-4 before it goes. Very inconsistent like I said
title: VRChat OSC Server crashing after avatar changes
